thread.title: Why Most Analysts Recommend ‘Hold’ for Ford Stock

title: Why Most Analysts Recommend ‘Hold’ for Ford Stock
text: Why Most Analysts Recommend ‘Hold’ for Ford Stock More Of the 21 analysts covering Ford (F) stock, most (76%) recommend “hold,” 19% recommend “buy,” and 5% recommend “sell.” Their 12-month target price of $12.28 for Ford implies a ~13% upside to its market price of $10.87.
